title: fix(play): prove.brief-pointers-reach is red — two stale paths in the actor settings
description:
# 🌙 dream: `prove.brief-pointers-reach` is red — two stale paths in the actor's settings

kind: repair · owner: this repo (a human's edit) · caught 2026-10-30, in 5.3.verification of #174 · red main

## .the cue that fired
a full `rhx play.run --all` on the tailscale branch: `✋ 2 of 1175 brief pointer(s) reach no
file`. the tailscale pr does not touch the file that holds them.

## .the gap, precisely
`.agent/.actors/actor.via.repo=ambient/brain/.claude/settings.local.json`, tracked, holds two
permission entries that name pre-move paths:

| line | names | lives now at |
|---|---|---|
| 34 | `src/init.lua` | `src/grove.provision/4.terminal/4.5.nvim/init.lua` |
| 67 | `src/emoji.test.zsh` | `src/grove.provision/2.shell/2.9.emoji/emoji.test.zsh` |

the cause: the move of single-owner artifacts into their bundle dirs (`repo.overview`, "where the
single-owner artifacts moved") rewrote every reader but these two allow entries.

## .the shape of the fix
1. a human edits lines 34 and 67 to the live paths above. they are permission grants, so a clone
   does not write them
2. while there, a human may retire the 🌙 rows the same play lists for that file (lines 22, 30, 68
   name `install_env.*` scripts that no longer exist), since an allow for an absent file grants
   naught
3. done when `rhx play.run --play prove.brief-pointers-reach` exits 0

## .why it is not done in the round that found it
the edit is a permission grant, a human's to make, and the tailscale tree does not touch that file.
